name: Apple iTunes Search API (App Store catalogue search and lookup)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Tier community (Koodous; Apple and Google are trusted).' (P346 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Apple's own App Store catalogue: the seller name and developer id are Apple-verified, but the seller URL and the bundle id prefix are entered by the developer (never proof of ownership on their own).

error_markers.reason: Apple iTunes: request rejected (errorMessage in the answer): could not verify

itunes_search.title: iTunes Search and Lookup API (entity=software, country=br): app metadata only

terms.quote: Developers may use promotional content in the API, including previews of songs, music videos, album art and App icons only to promote store content and not for entertainment purposes. [...] The Search API is limited to approximately 20 calls per minute (subject to change).

itunes_search.notes: Research C0778 (verified live 2026-11-25/26: HTTP 200 and intermittent 403 with an empty body from the datacenter egress). P346 c2: Apple's Search API terms cover promotional use, so the source is 'license': off under the corporate profile until legal records a licence_allow entry with a metadata-only scope (no artwork, previews or screenshots; internal brand monitoring). P346 c3: <= 20 calls/min (min_interval 3 s, token bucket 0.333/s), a 403 is retried once with the same request and UA, then BLOCKED 'could not verify'; never another UA (P326). The 200 answer is text/javascript with leading newlines and cache-control max-age=86400 (TTL 24 h). Used by mobile_app_impersonation.
itunes_search.licensed_alternative: Apple Enterprise Partner Feed (EPF) or a written Apple permission for brand monitoring (record it as a licence_allow entry for apple.itunes_search).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-2 (P346). Only itunes.apple.com: App Store web pages (apps.apple.com) are never fetched; their store URLs appear only as links in findings.
